title: Experts disagree on PAQAD_STAGE_HELPER_MATCHER
context:
Chief architect: the second check inside the hook is the guarantee; the per-boundary tests in the other claim prove it and should be written too.

Target: PAQAD_STAGE_HELPER_MATCHER
- integration-architect: the matcher accepts both paqad-<stage> (npm route) and paqad:paqad-<stage> (plugin namespace), and the hook re-checks with stageFromAgentType so an over-broad host match never seeds a non-stage paqad-* agent such as paqad-expert
- qa-engineer: boundary cases need a test each: paqad-documentation-sync (hyphen) maps to the documentation_sync ledger stage, paqad-documentation_sync and xpaqad-planning do not match, and paqad:paqad-checks matches; the regex and stageFromAgentType must agree on all of them
